summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a routine Form -6K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) aggregating 13 exhibits published 1-28 October 2026. Contents are ordinary housekeeping: monthly voting-rights and capital notices, a Sharesave Scheme share issuance of 9,636 ordinary shares, repeated transaction-in-own-shares and share-buyback-programme announcements, PDMR dealing disclosures, a TR-1 major-holdings notification, and board/committee changes. Issued capital is 2,157,761,532 shares with 132,648,864 held in treasury. No transaction, offer, or strategic event is announced; watch nothing beyond ongoing buyback execution.
